subject: Hosted API commit increase & temporary burst request
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@streamwave.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-26T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Request to increase hosted commit & adjust rate bands

Hi Tessa,

Quick note — we ran into another usage spike over the weekend and our current 1.2M token/month commit is no longer covering production traffic. Attached is a short usage extract (usage-report-Oct.csv) showing a sustained +3x week-on-week increase for our personalization pipeline.

Can Redwood support a bump to 4M tokens/month as a new committed tier? Also need clarity on: 1) sustained per-second token / request rate (we occasionally hit 60+ rps in bursts), 2) short-term burst allowance while we migrate caching, and 3) overage pricing if we exceed the commit before the next billing cycle.

We'd like to propose starting the new commit on Nov 1st if feasible. Procurement will loop in Sara once we have high-level commercials.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Engineering
StreamWave Inc.

Attachments: usage-report-Oct.csv (CSV summary, 42KB)
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@streamwave.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-26T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request to increase hosted commit & adjust rate bands

Hi Liam — thanks for the context and the report. Appreciate the heads-up.

Short answer: yes, we can support an increase to a 4M token/month committed tier and raise the burst/request limits for your routes while you finish the caching migration. High-level options (we can formalize in an amendment):

- Option A (Commit Tier): 4,000,000 tokens/mo committed. Effective Nov 1. Unit price on committed tokens: $0.00080 / token (reflects a 12% discount vs hosted list). Includes a guaranteed sustained throughput of 40 token/sec per dedicated route, with burst capacity up to 75 req/sec aggregated per account subject to quota policies.
- Option B (Ramp + Burst): Start with a temporary uplift to 2.5M for 30 days while we implement prefix caching, then move to 4M on Dec 1. Temporary burst allowance up to 100 req/sec for the first 2 weeks (additional fees apply).
- Overage: Outside of committed tokens, bill at $0.00105 / token. We can cap monthly overage at a negotiated threshold for the first 2 billing cycles if you want predictability.

I've attached a simple pricing workbook (proposed-commit.xlsx) with scenario math. If you want, Kar (cc'd) can run the revenue/usage forecast and we can propose a short credit for the first month to smooth the ramp.

If you confirm which option you prefer I will initiate the amendment and loop in Legal (Marissa) to scope any contract language.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-commit.xlsx (Excel, 18KB)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@streamwave.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Sara Patel <sara@streamwave.ai>
Date: 2026-10-27T08:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request to increase hosted commit & adjust rate bands

Thanks Tessa — that helps. A couple of clarifying points from our side:

1) Burst behavior: the bursts are short (2–7s) but frequent. We care more about request/second limits than token/sec. Our internal memcache update will reduce token churn but not the initial ramp.
2) Billing cadence: we prefer a single monthly invoice with a clear overage cap for the first quarter.
3) If you can offer a modest onboarding credit (even 5–10% of the first month) to offset migration work, that would be helpful.

If Option B is easiest operationally we could do that but would like a firm guarantee on the short-term burst allowance and a defined overage cap. Sara (procurement) is cc'd and will take over contract language once your Legal sends a draft.

—Liam

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-28T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: StreamWave commit/credit recommendation

Tessa / Marissa — internal note on approach after Liam's reply.

Proposal summary (sales ops + commercial):
- Approve Option B with a 30-day ramp: 2.5M for Nov, transition to 4M Dec 1.
- Provide a one-time onboarding credit equal to 8% of the Nov invoice (applied as a bill credit).
- Short-term burst guarantee: up to 100 req/sec for first 14 days from Nov 1; after that revert to 75 req/sec guaranteed.
- Overage pricing: $0.00105 / token; cap overage charges at $15k/month for the first 2 cycles.

Ask: Marissa, please prepare a short amendment (1–2 pages) that captures the ramp, credit, burst allowance, and the overage cap. Rishi, can you confirm technical viability of 100 req/sec burst from an infra perspective (we should confirm there are no region-level constraints)?

Attaching our tech/data sheet for signal to legal: redwood-tds.pdf

Thanks,
Kar

Attachments: redwood-tds.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@streamwave.ai>, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: sara@streamwave.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-30T16:45:00-04:00
Subject: Draft amendment and MoU for StreamWave commit uplift

Hi all — attaching a short amendment and a draft MoU that reflects the ramp approach Kar proposed. Highlights:

- Nov 1–30: temporary commit = 2.5M tokens (billing at committed rate), onboarding credit = 8% applied to Nov invoice.
- Dec 1 onward: committed tier = 4.0M tokens / month.
- Burst: temporary allowance up to 100 req/sec for first 14 days; after that guaranteed 75 req/sec per account.
- Overage: $0.00105 / token, capped at $15k/month for the first 2 billing cycles.

Please review the draft and flag any material concerns (legal or technical). If approved, I'll upload to DocuSign and send to Liam + Sara for signature.

DocuSign link will be provided once we have final signers.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Signed-MoU-draft.pdf (DOCX/PDF combo, 32KB)
Related link: https://docusign.com/signed-link/abc123
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@streamwave.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@streamwave.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Draft amendment and MoU for StreamWave commit uplift — accepted

Marissa / Tessa — this looks good to us. We accept the ramp approach and the onboarding credit. Please send the final DocuSign and confirm the billing contact for the PO (we will push PO to accounts-payable once we have the DocuSign).

Billing contact for StreamWave: Sarah Nguyen <ap@streamwave.ai>

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We'll sign as soon as the DocuSign arrives.

—Liam
